All summary-sourced (verifiedAgainstExecutedDoc:false). Citations are the broker's own 'Doc/Sec' references — verify against the executed leases.

options.exerciseConditions: Three consecutive 5-year options; written notice ≥180 days prior to the then-current expiration.

goDarkRight.summary: Tenant may cease operations at any time. LANDLORD RECAPTURE: if dark >120 consecutive days (excl. casualty/remodel/assignment-marketing), Landlord may terminate on 60 days' notice; voided if Tenant (a) within 10 days notifies it's negotiating an assignment/sublease and effects it within 90 days, or (b) resumes within the 60-day period. On termination Landlord pays Tenant unamortized TI (straight-line over first 10 yrs), capped at $2,500,000. Recapture is Landlord's sole remedy.
